defaultAiDependency: No developer-hosted production AI endpoint, protected operator credentials or user authentication service is provisioned in this environment. Existing external-provider integration requires explicit configuration/consent. These host model processes are test fixtures only and are not a deployed NEXUS service.
decisions: Do not add 2B or 4B weights to CORE or promote these candidates as approved.
4B host peak RSS is about 4.30 GiB before Android runtime/camera; do not recommend it automatically to the A03.
Keep original real failures and unmodified generated text; no canned apology, typo rewrite or repetition removal has been introduced.
Treat multimodal pipeline verification separately from general language quality.
